mapper.select: SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC
SELECT priority AS priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY priority

SELECT t.handler_id AS handlerId, u.nickname AS handlerName, COUNT(*) AS resolvedCount FROM ticket_info t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.handler_id = u.id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'RESOLVED' AND t.handler_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.handler_id, u.nickname ORDER BY resolvedCount DESC, t.handler_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{date} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) FROM ticket_log WHERE event_type = 'STATUS_CHANGED' AND content LIKE %%, to=RESOLVED%' AND create_time >= #{date} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COALESCE( CAST(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, first_resolved.first_time)) AS SIGNED), 0 ) FROM ( SELECT ticket_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_time FROM ticket_log WHERE event_type = 'STATUS_CHANGED' AND content LIKE %%, to=RESOLVED%' AND create_time >= #{date} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY ticket_id ) first_resolved JOIN ticket_info t ON t.id = first_resolved.ticket_id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0
